name: Kagawa Akihiko
source:
He is a newly graduated editor who joined “Satellite Publishing” this spring. When he was a student, he dreamed of becoming a writer, and he had made submissions, but he was unsuccessful in all of them due to a lack of talent. However, he could not give up his dream and joined the publishing company. 

He is a slender, handsome man, but because of his background, he has few friends and no experience with women. He tends to get caught up in Shizuka's mysterious pace and is easily carried away.

At first Saki looks at him as an enemy, but he is a very mature young man who has the sense not to compete with her. He has lived alone for a long time and is good at housework in general. He calls Shizuka “Takamura-sensei” in public.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/shosetsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
